main.src: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶。
main.en: Homage to the Three Jewels.

main.src: 南無阿唎耶。婆盧羯帝爍缽囉耶。
main.zh: 皈依聖者；觀自在（觀世音）
main.en: Homage to the noble one, Avalokiteshvara (Guanyin), the Lord who looks down freely.
main.simp: 皈依圣者；观自在（观世音）

main.en: The bodhisattva, the awakened being.
The great being, the mahasattva.
The one of great compassion.

main.zh: 唵，神聖的起首音；能除一切怖畏
main.en: Om, the sacred opening sound; the remover of all fears.
main.simp: 唵，神圣的起首音；能除一切怖畏

main.src: 數怛那怛寫。南無悉吉慄埵伊蒙阿唎耶。
main.zh: 能守護救度；皈依這位聖者
main.en: Protector and saviour; homage to this noble one.
main.simp: 能守护救度；皈依这位圣者

main.src: 婆盧吉帝室佛囉愣馱婆。
main.en: The Lord who looks down freely, the Blue-Necked One.
Homage to the Blue-Necked One.
The heart mantra, great radiance.
Accomplishing every benefit.

main.src: 阿逝孕。薩婆薩哆那摩婆薩哆那摩婆伽。
main.zh: 無上殊勝；利益一切眾生
main.en: Unsurpassed; bringing benefit to all beings.
main.simp: 无上殊胜；利益一切众生

main.zh: 遠離一切障礙；即說咒曰
main.en: Free of every obstacle; thus he spoke the mantra.
main.simp: 远离一切障碍；即说咒曰

main.en: Om, the one who looks upon the world; the Lord of the world.
The one beyond the world; please come.
The great bodhisattva.
All, all; remember, remember.
Great heart, lord of the great heart.
Accomplish, accomplish the work to be done.
Bold, bold; ever victorious.
The greatly victorious one.
Uphold, uphold; the upholder of the world.
The sovereign one; go forth, go forth.
May my stains be cleared away; liberation.
Come, come; hear, hear.
Calling on the Buddha's child, asking for blessing.

main.zh: 降下甘露法雨；祈求佛的加被
main.en: Let the rain of the nectar of the Dharma fall; asking for the Buddha's blessing.
main.simp: 降下甘露法雨；祈求佛的加被

main.en: Calling on the power of the mantra, to take away the afflictions.
Calling on the power of the mantra, to rest in the heart.
Flow, flow; be accomplished, be accomplished.

main.src: 蘇盧蘇盧。菩提夜菩提夜。
main.en: Nectar, nectar; awaken, awaken.
Cause awakening, cause awakening.
The compassionate one; the Blue-Necked One.
The bold and steadfast one; take away fear.
So be it; the accomplished one.

main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；大成就者
main.en: So be it; the greatly accomplished one.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；大成就者

main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；瑜伽成就者
main.en: So be it; the one accomplished in yoga.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；瑜伽成就者

main.en: The sovereign one; so be it.
The Blue-Necked One; so be it.

main.zh: 降伏魔障者；願得圓滿成就
main.en: The conqueror of obstructing forces; so be it.
main.simp: 降伏魔障者；愿得圆满成就

main.en: The auspicious lion-faced one.

main.src: 娑婆訶。娑婆摩訶阿悉陀夜。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；無礙大成就者
main.en: So be it; the greatly accomplished one without hindrance.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；无碍大成就者

main.src: 娑婆訶。者吉囉阿悉陀夜。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；持輪成就者
main.en: So be it; the accomplished one who holds the wheel.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；持轮成就者

main.src: 娑婆訶。波陀摩羯悉陀夜。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；持蓮花成就者
main.en: So be it; the accomplished one who holds the lotus.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；持莲花成就者

main.src: 娑婆訶。那囉謹墀皤伽囉耶。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；青頸的世尊
main.en: So be it; the Blessed One, the Blue-Necked.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；青颈的世尊

main.src: 娑婆訶。摩婆利勝羯囉夜。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；持法螺者
main.en: So be it; the bearer of the conch.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；持法螺者

main.src: 娑婆訶。南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶。
main.zh: 願得圓滿成就；皈依三寶
main.en: So be it; homage to the Three Jewels.
main.simp: 愿得圆满成就；皈依三宝

main.en: Homage to the noble one, the Lord who looks down freely.
The sovereign one; so be it.
Om, may it be accomplished; the mantra.
Auspicious; so be it.
